# Vuneli

> AI-powered sustainability platform for SMEs in Cyprus and across the EU. Track carbon footprint, generate CSRD/VSME-ready reports, benchmark against industry peers, and stay compliant — in EUR, with GDPR-compliant data handling and full English + Greek (el-CY) support.

Vuneli helps small and medium enterprises measure Scope 1/2/3 emissions, model Cyprus-specific energy costs, run compliance checks against EU CSRD/ESRS/VSME frameworks, and produce audit-ready sustainability reports powered by AI. Pricing is transparent in EUR and includes Cyprus VAT (19%).
